package.name: open_amr_isaac_hardware
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface that bridges joint commands / states to an Isaac Sim articulation over sensor_msgs/JointState topics (OpenAMR sim/scripts/arm_bridge.py). Based on joint_state_topic_hardware_interface 1.1.0 (Apache-2.0, ros2_control Development Team), changed where the simulator needs it: commands are stamped with the controller's sample time (write()'s time argument), non-finite commands are never sent, the latest state is handed between threads under a lock, and commands start at the measured state.
